items.title: Audio2Tool: Speak, Call, Act -- A Dataset for Benchmarking Speech Tool Use
items.title_zh: Audio2Tool：评测语音工具调用的数据集
items.summary: Audio2Tool is a dataset of roughly 30,000 queries for evaluating tool calling by speech language models across smart car, smart home and wearables domains. It spans direct commands through multi-intent and needle-in-a-haystack tasks, uses zero-shot voice cloning and varied noise profiles, and shows strong simple-command performance but significant degradation under compositional and acoustic challenges.

items.title: Agentic Frameworks for Reasoning Tasks: An Empirical Study
items.title_zh: 推理任务中的智能体框架：一项实证研究
items.summary: The study evaluates 22 widely used agentic frameworks on BBH, GSM8K and ARC under a unified setting, finding 19 completed all three and 12 showed stable accuracy of 74.6-75.9% at 4-6 seconds and 0.14-0.18 cents per task. Failures traced mainly to orchestration, including uncontrolled context growth, costly retry loops and exhausted API quotas, while GSM8K accuracy fell to 44.35%.

items.title: Agentic Large Language Models for Training-Free Neuro-Radiological Image Analysis
items.title_zh: 面向神经影像分析的免训练智能体大语言模型
items.summary: A training-free agentic pipeline has LLMs including GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.6 orchestrate off-the-shelf tools for brain MRI workflows, from preprocessing and tumor segmentation to longitudinal assessment. The authors release a benchmark of image-prompt-answer tuples.

items.title: Authority Signals in Claude AI Health Citations: A Descriptive Analysis Using the Authority Signals Framework
items.title_zh: Claude 健康类引用中的权威信号：基于权威信号框架的描述性分析
items.summary: Analyzing 3,075 HealthSearchQA consumer health questions that yielded 10,038 citations, the study finds established institutional sources account for 97.8% of Claude's citations, with medical institutions, government resources and professional associations the most frequent organization types. The top 10 organizations supply 57.8% of citations, and the authors propose the Authority Signals Framework as a cross-platform evaluation tool.

items.title: Debate as Reward: A Multi-Agent Reward System for Scientific Ideation via RL Post-Training
items.title_zh: 以辩论为奖励：面向科学构思的 RL 后训练多智能体奖励系统
items.summary: The authors propose a multi-agent reward function for RL post-training of scientific idea generation that is designed to resist reward hacking, and train with an unbiased Group Relative Policy Optimization variant on the ICLR-320 dataset. They report gains over state-of-the-art baselines on expert-evaluated novelty, feasibility and effectiveness.

items.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy for CT Report Generation
items.title_zh: MARCH：面向 CT 报告生成的多智能体放射科临床层级
items.summary: MARCH emulates a radiology department's hierarchy, using a Resident Agent for initial drafting with multi-scale CT feature extraction, Fellow Agents for retrieval-augmented revision, and an Attending Agent that runs stance-based consensus discourse to resolve diagnostic discrepancies. On RadGenome-ChestCT it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in clinical fidelity and linguistic accuracy.

items.title: Complete Cyclic Subtask Graphs for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Flexibility, Cost, and Bottlenecks in Long-Horizon Workflows
items.title_zh: 工具使用型 LLM 智能体的完全循环子任务图：长程工作流中的灵活性、成本与瓶颈
items.summary: The paper studies fully connected cyclic subtask graphs in which a state-analysis-and-routing agent selects transitions from natural-language criteria, comparing them with ReAct and dependency-directed workflows on TextCraft, ALFWorld and Finance-Agent. It concludes cyclic graphs are best treated as a diagnostic workflow-control tool: revisitation helps in partially observable recovery settings but adds overhead in prerequisite chains and cannot replace stronger retrieval and verification in open-ended synthesis.

items.title: Don't Start What You Can't Finish: A Counterfactual Audit of Support-State Triage in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 不要开始你无法完成的事：LLM 智能体支持状态分诊的反事实审计
items.summary: The Support-State Triage Audit tests whether agents can diagnose why a task is blocked before acting. Default execution overcommitted on 41.7% of non-complete tasks, while typed preflight or action-only prompting reached 91.7% typed deferral accuracy in a single-context-window evaluation.

items.title: espressif/esp-claw
items.title_zh: espressif/esp-claw：面向 IoT 设备的“聊天编程”AI 智能体框架
items.summary: ESP-Claw is a C-based AI agent framework for IoT devices from Espressif that takes a chat-coding approach to building device behavior.
